Identify the speaker and, for a retelling, the original speaker and statement day.

speaker is who says it in this item: the outlet, the author or the person quoted. original_who is the party whose statement, figure or action it is, even when the item reports it without attribution ("the insurer agreed to buy the broker": the insurer; "the regulator fined the bank, a newspaper reported": the regulator); the outlet or author only for its own estimate, analysis or unnamed-source report. original_day is the day that party made it, as an ISO day when the item gives one ("signed on 3 March 2026": 2026-03-03), empty when the item gives none or only a month, and the publication day only when the item is that party's own release, filing, call or analysis.
